visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of anthropomorphic dogs, primarily Corgis, are dressed in cream-colored body suits with large, brown mushroom-shaped hats. They are standing on a busy urban street in Taipei at night, with the illuminated Taipei 101 skyscraper in the background. Fireworks explode in the sky. The dogs hold burning sparklers and dance with a rhythmic, bouncing motion, their mouths open in happy expressions. (2) The scene cuts to a different group of mushroom-hatted dogs, including French Bulldogs and Pugs, dancing in front of the Arc de Triomphe in Paris. The ground is wet, reflecting the city lights and fireworks bursting above the monument. The dogs maintain the same synchronized dancing movement. (3) The dogs appear in Tokyo, with the red Tokyo Tower behind them. They are positioned on a multi-lane road with city lights and fireworks filling the night sky. The camera is eye-level, capturing their joyful faces and the sparkling flares they hold. (4) The setting shifts to a snowy, mountainous landscape. Alaskan Malamutes or Huskies in mushroom costumes dance under a vibrant green aurora borealis. The ground is covered in snow, and the dogs' fur and costumes appear textured and detailed. (5) The dogs are seen in London, with Big Ben and the Palace of Westminster in the background. They dance on a bridge or roadway over the River Thames as fireworks illuminate the clock tower. (6) A group of Pugs in mushroom suits are dancing near the Sydney Opera House. The harbor water reflects the bright yellow and green fireworks. (7) The final scene is in Times Square, New York. Corgis dance amidst the neon billboards and a 'NEW YEAR' sign, with colorful fireworks overhead and a large crowd visible in the background.

(2) As the music continues with a consistent tempo, the firework sounds repeat rhythmically, synchronized with the visual appearance of pyrotechnics on the screen. The texture remains bright and celebratory with no vocal narrative. (3) The percussive SFX of fireworks become more frequent, creating a dense acoustic landscape alongside the driving BGM.
